title: Write features/daw/your_warp_markers.feature and fixture manifests (red)
description:
## Intent
Specs first for M4.

## Scope
- `features/daw/your_warp_markers.feature`: all scenarios of the four M4 stories; steps in `features/daw/STEPS.md`; runner `crates/apricity-cli/tests/daw_cli.rs` (compile/explain/render through the binary; markup and re-analysis steps shell out to `PYTHONPATH=analysis analysis/.venv/bin/python -m apricity_analyze…` and are tagged `@python`, skipped with a visible message when the venv is absent, never silently).
- Fixture manifests with warp markers of yours (valid and each invalid case).

## Verify
`safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-cli --test daw_cli` fails on the new scenarios for the right reason.

---
**Toolchain:** every Bash call starts with `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2`; run builds and tests under the watchdog: `safe-run.sh -- <command>` (6 GB / 20 min cap; do not edit it). At most two Rust-building agents at once.
**Protocol:** specs first (write the scenario, watch it fail, then code); keep a running log with `kbs comment` (decisions, problems, attempts, outcomes); paste the tail of **Verify** before asking for review; never commit, push or close (the reviewer does, after re-running Verify). Never write the DAW's brand name anywhere.
